Imtiyaz vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 August,
2023

?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54922

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9696 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Imtiyaz
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Bajpai
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rama Shankar
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed by the learned Aga is taken on record.

2. Heard Shri Ashutosh Kumar Bajpai, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh learned AGA-I for the State and Shri Rama Shankar Tiwari, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the record.
3.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant Imtiyaz with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.48 of 2023, under Sections 364, 376, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Ranipur, District Bahraich.
4. Learned counsel has invited attention of this Court towards the statement of PW1 prosecutrix recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. which indicates that it is a case of consent.
He has submitted that the cross examination of the prosecutrix does not support the prosecution case.
He has further submitted that after looking to the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and the case of consent, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh, learned AGA-I for the State has invited attention of this Court towards the statement of prosecutrix PW1 before the trial court in which she has specifically stated that the applicant had taken her to Telengana and confined in a room and rape was committed by him.
As per school leaving certificate, date of birth of the prosecutrix is 20.06.2005 and she was minor at the relevant time.

He submitted that if the prosecutrix is minor,
her consent has no meaning therefore, bail is liable to be rejected.

6. Shri Rama Shankar Tiwari, learned counsel for the complainant has also opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the statement recorded before the trial Court the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution case.

7. Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case, the statement of the PW1 has been recorded before the trial court in which the prosecutrix has specifically stated before the court that she was confined in a room and rape was committed by the applicant.
The record reveals that the prosecutrix was minor at the relevant time therefore, the argument of consent has no meaning and will not support the case of the applicant in any manner.
In my opinion, it is not a fit case for bail 8.
The application for bail of applicant Imtiyaz is hereby, rejected.
